title: WAW to LIS cancellation with 5 days notice
input_text:
From: notifications@vistula-air.com
To: anna.kowalska@example.com
Subject: Flight VQ401 Cancellation Notice

Dear Anna Kowalska,

We regret to inform you that flight VQ401 scheduled from Warsaw Chopin (WAW) to Lisbon (LIS) on May 15, 2026, departing at 10:00 and arriving at 13:30, has been cancelled due to operational reorganization.

Notice of cancellation is provided 5 days prior to scheduled departure. No alternative rerouting is available at this time. Under applicable regulations, you are entitled to reimbursement or rerouting, as well as assistance.

Vistula Air Customer Service
